G001.target_statement: Buy a specific planned gift (e.g. a really good cake for my girlfriend) on Instagram, mainly on special occasions such as Valentine's Day
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: T010 涉众明确说明主要在情人节等特殊场合用 Instagram 购物，并给女友买蛋糕等特定礼物；主体（涉众）、对象（蛋糕/礼物）、情境（特殊场合）与强度（mainly）一致。C002 找蛋糕账号下单与之同义，合并承接，不另建重复节点。

G002.target_statement: Find what I'm looking for (e.g. cakes / cake vendors) using the search bar, entering the name of what I want and adding the location if I don't see it immediately
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T012 涉众描述用右上方搜索栏输入想找的名称（cakes），并在找不到时加地点名再搜；这是同一查找动作的核心动作加局部条件，按'一个动作的多个限定'保留为一个目标，不机械拆成两项。搜索会返回所在地区供应商（C008）为系统现状/正面评价，作为背景而非独立要求。

G003.target_statement: Get the vendor's phone number / contact info from its account bio and reach out by WhatsApp or a normal call to place the order
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: T010 与 T016 明确描述从账户 bio 看电话/联系方式，再通过电话或 WhatsApp 联系下单，是涉众 'the main way in which I purchase stuff on Instagram' 的独立动作；主体、对象、方式一致。

G004.target_statement: Prefer to reach out to the number the vendor specified rather than via in-app Instagram chat, because communication is quicker
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: T016 'I would always prefer to ... reach out to the number they've specified' 是明确表达的偏好，对象（商家指定号码）、方向（相对站内 chat）、理由（更快）齐全。按目标边界保留 prefer 强度，不升级为强制，也不把偏好变成全体默认。

G005.target_statement: For clothing/dresses, view a vendor's showcased designs on their account, then go to an actual market and ask for those same designs
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: T010 明确说明看商家展示的设计（see the designs they have in store）后去实体市场求购同款（go to an actual market and ask for those），是独立用例。个别触发词为转写噪声，但核心语义由上述两句支撑；不静默改写原文，识别风险另记 limitations 与问题。

G006.target_statement: Browse images and products with an open mind (no particular product in mind) and pick something unplanned, choosing in the moment
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: T022 涉众明确描述有时无特定商品、开放心态浏览大量图片/产品并挑到未预想的商品；C020/C022 的情境与价值并入本目标。状态/选择类意图按边界保留，不因缺动作句式删除。

G007.target_statement: When in a new place, quickly find local vendors and see their location, phone number and products via their account bios
G007.label: inferred
G007.rationale: T056 是对'使用 Instagram 的初始动机'的回答：到新地方不认识供应商，IG 通过商家 bio 快速给出位置/电话/产品，且对短暂停留者 'very, very helpful'。由此正面推断涉众希望在新地方快速找到本地供应商信息；'just out of convenience' 仅说明非主动挑选平台，不否定该查找目的。origin 与 label 同为 inferred，理由与假设已写明。

G008.target_statement: Be able to use / view the app (including just viewing a vendor's profile) without signing in, and browse without anyone knowing I'm online
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T024 与 T052 多次明确表达'希望免登录即可使用/查看（含仅查看商家资料）'及'不想被人知道在线'，T053 采访者归纳为 anonymous browsing、T054 'Exactly. Yeah.' 确认。跨窗指代与确认已回查。不升级为强制；'anonymous posting'（T071）为采访者引入、涉众仅泛泛确认，未纳入本目标，另记问题。

G009.target_statement: Limit my use of the app - log out, delete the app / web history, and access it only when I have a specific need
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: T052 'so that I don't use it very often' / 'only access it when I need something' / 'how I try to manage the use' 与 T032 'stay away ... only use it when I have a need' 为明确自我约束意图；登出/删除为明确选定方式，随目标保留。C042 同义并入，C051 应对方式并入 context，不另建重复节点。

G010.target_statement: Avoid being unconsciously influenced by social/clothing content into buying things I did not plan
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: T032 'that is one of the reasons why I try to stay away from it a lot' 明确把避免无意识影响作为远离的动机，是 avoid 型目标。其中'影响'属涉众顾虑/信念，不当已验证事实；影响范围自述不确定（I don't know ...），写入 context 并另记问题。与 G009（限制使用频率）为不同结果、各自有独立依据，故拆分而非合并。

G011.target_statement: Avoid losing money to malicious vendor accounts that ask for payment upfront and never deliver the product
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: T014 描述恶意账户'先收款、不发货、丢钱、无法追查'的具体损失情境，涉众以 'I didn't lose my money' 及 T062 'it saved me some money' 表明主动避免该结果，是明确 avoid 目标。抱怨/单次经历不自动推广为全部账户都恶意。

G012.target_statement: Ensure the product is delivered before I pay the vendor (to avoid being scammed)
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: T014 'you have to deliver before I pay you' 是涉众明确选定的、带 have to 强度的付款规则，且'没丢钱'被归因于它。它是 G011 的实现方式，但有独立结果意图与明确强度，按'一目标一核心动作'单独保留为方式目标，用于承接选定方式，不藏在解释里。

G013.target_statement: Use a vendor gallery's likes and comments (engagement) to judge whether the account is reputable or malicious - older products should have more engagement; uniform engagement across all products is suspicious
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: T024 'helped me to spot ... malicious account' 与 T062 'It just helps me to know which accounts ... I should buy from' 明确说明画廊点赞/评论被用来判断账户可信/恶意；C029/C063/C064 的判断逻辑与用途并入。采访者 T061 所称 ranking system 被 T062 否定，本目标不据该总结建立。

G014.target_statement: Keep my account private so that only very close friends can see my posts and see when I'm online
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: T026 'I make sure I have a private account' 与 'I would expect that just my very close friends would see I'm online' 是对现有私密状态的明确维持意图（make sure / expect），按边界'已实现能力不自动成为要求，但有维持意图则为有效目标'保留。

G015.target_statement: Be careful about posting about my life and my stuff on social media, and avoid people preying on my life
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: T026 'I tend to be careful with ... posting about your life' 与 'weed away the evils of ... people preying on your life' 是明确的谨慎/避免意图；'could come back to hurt you' 是涉众信念，作为动机保留、不当事实。C035 预期结果并入本目标；私密账户（G014）为其实现方式，单独建目标以便承接联系。

G016.target_statement: Stay connected with people on Instagram so that if I lose their phone number / contact / email, I can still reconnect with them via the app
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: T030 明确说明关注对方后即使丢失电话/即时联系方式/邮箱，仍可通过 Instagram 重连，且因自己常换号'is a really good benefit for me'；主体、结果、情境一致。社交组件虽被采访者列为可单独成题，但涉众确实表达了该目标，故保留。

G017.target_statement: Have vendors put the price of products on their business pages (so I would not need to ask for the cost)
G017.label: insufficient
G017.rationale: T058 涉众先说 'they should put ... the price'（提议页面标价），随即用 'But I I would imagine that if they did that ... they will not get the feedback they need on pricing' 给出相反理由（标价会减少询价、商家失去定价反馈）。同一条件下明确让步且无有效支持可裁决，按证据口径混合冲突无法决定时为 insufficient 并提出人工问题；不为凑数升级为 direct。
supported_parts: 涉众提及商家页面目前不标价格、自己需电话询价（现状/事实）
unsupported_parts: 商家应标价这一要求是否被涉众最终认可（其后自我让步）
若认可，该要求针对商家还是平台、强度如何
reasoning_steps: T058 先以 'should put' 提议在商家页面标价
紧接 'But I would imagine that if they did that...' 给出反方后果（询价减少、商家失去定价反馈）
按 evidence-rules 混合冲突无法决定时为 insufficient 并提出人工问题
